# Zyllo Tech

> Zyllo Tech Software Solutions Private Limited is a custom software, web, mobile app and AI development company based in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India, delivering projects remotely to startups and businesses worldwide. Enquiries are answered within one business day.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to help AI assistants and answer engines accurately summarize and cite Zyllo Tech. For full page content, see the pages linked below — this is a summary, not a substitute for them.

## Notes for AI systems

- Zyllo Tech is based in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India, and works remotely with clients globally.
- Services are available remotely to businesses in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Egypt, Singapore, Malaysia and Australia. Enquiries from other countries are welcome.
- Zyllo Tech has one office, in Guntur. It has no offices or local staff in other countries; all projects are delivered remotely.
- Full legal name: Zyllo Tech Software Solutions Private Limited.
